title: "A549_h1299_cell_trace_analysis"
output: html_notebook
---



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```



```{r}
# Summarize data: calculate mean and sd per gRNA and cell line

A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1 <- read_excel("data/A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1.xlsx")
replicate_number<- A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1 %>% group_by(Cell_line, gRNA) %>% summarise(count=n())

NT_mean<- A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1 %>% filter(gRNA =="NT") %>% group_by(Cell_line) %>% summarise(NT_mean=mean(median_celltrace_in_GFP_poz_Cells)) %>% ungroup()

A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1<- left_join(A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1, NT_mean, by="Cell_line")
A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1<- A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1 %>% mutate(ratio_to_NT=(median_celltrace_in_GFP_poz_Cells/NT_mean))

summary_df <- A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1 %>%
  group_by(gRNA, Cell_line) %>%
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(ratio_to_NT),
            sd_expr = sd(ratio_to_NT),
            .groups = 'drop')

custom_order <- c("NT", "SNHG15_G2", "SNHG15_G3","SNHG16_G1", "SNHG16_G2", "MYC_G2", "MYC_G3")

A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1$gRNA <- factor(A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1$gRNA, levels = custom_order)
summary_df$gRNA <- factor(summary_df$gRNA, levels = custom_order)




h1299_celltrace_exp_1<- A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1 %>% filter(Cell_line=="NCIH1299") %>% droplevels()

A549_celltrace_exp_1<- A549_h1299_celltrace_exp_1 %>% filter(Cell_line=="A549") %>% droplevels()

```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)

stat.test_1 <- h1299_celltrace_exp_1 %>%
  wilcox_test(ratio_to_NT ~ gRNA, ref.group = "NT") %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

stat.test_1 <- stat.test_1 %>%
  mutate(p.adj.signif = case_when(
    p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE          ~ "ns"
  ))

H1299_Cell_trace<-ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = summary_df %>% filter(Cell_line=="NCIH1299"),
           aes(x = gRNA, y = mean_expr),
           stat = "identity",fill="lightgray", width = 0.7, color="black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_df %>% filter(Cell_line=="NCIH1299"),
                aes(x = gRNA, ymin = mean_expr - sd_expr, ymax = mean_expr + sd_expr),
                width = 0.5, size = 1, color="#333333") +
  geom_point(data=h1299_celltrace_exp_1, aes(x = gRNA, y=ratio_to_NT),size=2, color="black", alpha=0.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test_1,
    y.position = 5,
    step.increase = 0.1,
    label = "p.adj.signif"     # <-- shows *, **, ***
  )+
  theme_classic()+theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45))+
   ylab("CellTrace Flurescence Signal\nRatio to NT gRNA")+
  ggtitle("Cell Division Analysis\nNCI-H1299") 
  
  H1299_Cell_trace

```

```{r}
stat.test_2 <- A549_celltrace_exp_1 %>%
  wilcox_test(ratio_to_NT ~ gRNA, ref.group = "NT") %>%

A549_cell_trace<- ggplot() +
```

```{r}
ggsave(H1299_Cell_trace, filename = "H1299_cell_trace.svg", unit="cm", height = 10, width = 15, dpi=1000)
```
